d:
Thank you for your interest in a career at Larian Studios!

We’re always looking to connect with talented and passionate developers — especially those with expertise in engine programming. While we may not have an immediate opening at this time, by applying to this listing, you're expressing your interest in being considered for future opportunities at Larian Studios.

As a Motion Capture Engineer in our open application, you may be contacted when a role opens up that aligns with your skills and experience. These roles typically involve playing an active role during our MoCap and PCap shoots, supporting with hardware issues and setting up our camera systems, whilst maintaining a friendly and comfortable environment for both actors and the rest of the team.

We encourage you to use this opportunity to tell us about yourself — your background and skill!

In the meantime, please continue to check our Careers page regularly for any new positions that match your interests and skill set.

We appreciate your interest in Larian and look forward to the possibility of working together in the future.
